new_candidates.requirement: Pass each supplied .lzma input to the decoder once, in byte order.
new_candidates.target_route: The entry calls fuzz_code, which supplies the first half of the input and later refills lzma_code from the original input pointer.
new_candidates.failure_condition: When the first half is consumed, the refill repeats its prefix instead of supplying the remaining bytes. A complete valid .lzma input therefore is not decoded as supplied.
new_candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry makes one fuzz_code call, and the complete helper has no other refill route that advances past the initially supplied half.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: lzma_code advances next_in and reduces avail_in as the decoder consumes bytes.
The library test establishes that a complete supported .lzma input exists.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete entry uses this helper once for each fuzz input.

scope.summary: The changed dictionary-size reset is reached during ordinary first-time decoder allocation. The newly supplied call chain and build rule resolve the earlier change-coverage uncertainty. A separate preexisting input replay failure blocks the input foundation.

assessments.reason: A valid .lzma header within the first input half reaches LZMA1 decoder initialization. The fresh coder has dictionary size zero, so its first dictionary allocation executes the added reset.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The alone decoder parses the header and selects the LZMA1 decoder.
The selected decoder calls the changed initializer.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The helper can supply a complete 13-byte .lzma header in its first half.

build.reason: The recipe builds static liblzma with the default LZMA1 decoder and invokes the Makefile rule that compiles and links the fuzz target against that archive.

evidence.dependency_reason: The invoked Makefile selects target C files and links them to the archive.
The default decoder list includes LZMA1 and its source files.

input.reason: After lzma_code consumes the initial half, fuzz_code refills from the original pointer and repeats bytes already consumed. This prevents faithful delivery of complete supported .lzma inputs.

evidence.dependency_reason: lzma_code records consumption by advancing the stream pointer and reducing avail_in.
The alone decoder consumes the .lzma header sequentially.

lifecycle.reason: Each entry creates a fresh stream, initializes it, then ends it; the source initialization and end paths support that sequence.

evidence.dependency_reason: Decoder initialization handles its error path through the stream initialization macro.
lzma_end releases and clears the internal coder.

control_flow.reason: The supplied bodies trace lzma_code through alone_decode, its filter initializer, and the LZMA1 initializer to the changed dictionary allocation. Cleanup follows the entry's lzma_end call.

evidence.dependency_reason: The alone decoder selects and invokes its LZMA1 filter.
Filter initialization invokes the selected initializer.
This is the reached dictionary allocation and reset.

scope.prior_alarm_resolution: The supplied Makefile and decoder bodies resolve the earlier build and dispatch uncertainties. The input refill concern is established as a separate foundation failure.
